# IMDb

> > The world's most popular and authoritative source for movie, TV, and celebrity content, featuring comprehensive information on films, television shows, streaming content, and entertainment industry events.

IMDb provides detailed databases of movies, TV shows, and entertainment personalities, along with user ratings, reviews, and editorial content. The platform covers diverse genres including horror, action, anime, and psychological thrillers, while also tracking trending titles and industry events.

## Key Topics

- Horror films and subgenres
- Shōnen anime
- Trending movies and TV shows
- Japanese animation
- Psychological horror
- Action epics
- Vampire horror
- Anime movies
- Film festivals and awards
- Popular movie listings
- Demon Slayer
- Chainsaw Man
- Attack on Titan
- Jujutsu Kaisen
- Entertainment industry events

## Horror Genres & Subgenres

- [Horror - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000112/?ref_=ints_cat_12_in_i_5): Horror genre page with trending films and TV shows eliciting fear
- [Psychological Horror - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000114/?ref_=ints_cat_12_in_i_7): Psychological horror subgenre showcasing tension-driven films and shows
- [Vampire Horror - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000119/?ref_=int_sim_in_i_11): Vampire horror subgenre featuring supernatural bloodsucking creatures

## Anime & Japanese Animation

- [Shōnen - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000206/?ref_=int_sim_in_in_i_7): Shōnen anime subgenre page featuring action-packed titles for young males

## Action & Epic Films

- [Action Epic - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000002/?ref_=int_sim_in_i_2): Action epic subgenre featuring grand narratives and heroic journeys

## Events & Industry Resources

- [All events](https://m.imdb.com/event/all/?ref_=int_nv_menu): Comprehensive directory of film festivals, awards, and cinema events
